pages.text: A type item looks like a data item with a red border. It stands for a data type and is used to craft variable and constant items of that type.$(br2)Recipe: a data item, red dye and the item of the type, in any shape:
$(li)BOOLEAN: redstone torch$(li)INTEGER: sand$(li)FLOAT: red sand$(li)CHAR: oak plank$(li)STRING: string$(li)ARRAY: barrel$(li)HASH: chest$(li)STRUCT: scaffolding$(li)TIME: clock$(li)ERROR: campfire
